nodes.name: Paper Trade Webhook
nodes.notes: Attach an n8n HTTP Basic Auth credential after import. The backend should treat any 2xx response as accepted and use an outbox for delivery status.

nodes.name: Low-Noise Policy and Format
nodes.notes: Accepts v2 canonical payloads and the current legacy V1 event shape. Uses event-specific templates, converts UTC to IST, suppresses duplicates for 48 hours, and never recursively dumps arbitrary JSON.

nodes.name: Send Clean WhatsApp Message
nodes.notes: Create/select an HTTP Header Auth credential with header name X-API-Token and the rotated gateway token. Set n8n variables PAPER_TRADE_WHATSAPP_CHAT_ID and optionally PAPER_TRADE_WHATSAPP_GATEWAY_URL.
